正文解密 目录页 搜索  by@boavine（boavine@163.com）
 修复目录页by@天天的鸟蛋蛋
___

	同模板
	西瓜书屋：https://www.xiguasw.com （原）
	艾一小说：https://iyishus.com
	
___
目录页面解决办法 
boavine用的是这个，但是一碰到同模板的就不行了。
<js>
html=result.replace(/最新章节可能会延时显示.+?dl>/g,'');
result=html;
</js>
我用的是
<js>
html=result.replace(/.*?最新章节可能会延时显示.*?/g,'');
result=html;
</js>
完美解决同模板问题

<js>
url="https:"+result.match(/initTxt\("([^"]+)","[^"]+"\)/)[1];
r=String(java.ajax(url).match(/_txt_call\(([\s\S]+\})\)/)[1]);
var r = eval('(' + r + ')');
				if(r.content!=null){				
      var e = r.replace;
				for (var n in e) {
					var i = new RegExp(e[n], "ig");
					r.content = r.content.replace(i, n)
				}
				result=r.content
					}else{result="章节加载失败，或者容正在手打中，请【收藏本站】稍访问或者联系管理员更新~"}
</js>

  if (!data.uuid) data.uuid = String(Packages.java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString())
  if (!data.device_id) data.device_id = qmDateStamp() + qmRandomHex(48)
  if (!data.source_uid) data.source_uid = qmRandomHex(16)
  if (!data.mac) data.mac = '02:' + qmRandomHex(10).match(/../g).join(':')

function qmBuildParams() {
  var d = qmDevice.call(this)

    ['gender', d.gender], ['static_score', d.static_score], ['uuid', d.uuid],
    ['device-id', d.device_id], ['mac', d.mac], ['sourceuid', d.source_uid],
    ['sys-ver', d.sys_ver], ['phone-level', d.phone_level], ['app_ver', d.app_version],

    ['client-id', d.source_uid], ['brand', d.brand], ['make', d.make], ['net_env', '1']
  ]
  var parts = fields.map(function (item) { return JSON.stringify(item[0]) + ':' + JSON.stringify(String(item[1])) })
  return qmParamEncode('{' + parts.join(',') + '}')
}

function qmHeaderSign(token, qmParams) {
  var values = {
    'AUTHORIZATION': token || '', 'app-version': QM_APP_VERSION,
    'application-id': QM_APP_ID, 'channel': QM_CHANNEL, 'is-white': '0',
    'net-env': '1', 'platform': 'android', 'qm-params': qmParams, 'reg': ''
  }
  var order = ['AUTHORIZATION','app-version','application-id','channel','is-white','net-env','platform','qm-params','reg']
  var text = ''
  order.forEach(function (key) { text += key + '=' + values[key] })
  return qmSign(text)
}

function qmDay() {

  return d.getFullYear() + qmPad(d.getMonth() + 1, 2) + qmPad(d.getDate(), 2)

function qmParse(text) {
  text = String(text == null ? '' : text).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '').trim()
  if (!text) throw new Error('七猫接口返回空响应')
  var value
  try {
    value = JSON.parse(text)
  } catch (e) {
    throw new Error('七猫接口返回非 JSON，请检查网络或压缩响应')
  }
  if (value && value.v) {
    var plain = qmContentLayerDecode(value.v)
    if (plain) {
      try { value = JSON.parse(plain) }
      catch (e2) { throw new Error('七猫加密响应解码后不是 JSON') }
    }
  }
  return value
}

function qmForm(data) {
  return Object.keys(data).sort().map(function (key) {
    return encodeURIComponent(key) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(String(data[key]))
  }).join('&')
}

function qmParseJwt(token) {
  try {
    var part = String(token).split('.')[1].replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/')
    while (part.length % 4) part += '='
    var bytes = Packages.android.util.Base64.decode(part, 0)
    return JSON.parse(String(new Packages.java.lang.String(bytes, 'UTF-8')))
  } catch (e) { return {} }
}

function qmLogin(force) {
  var runtimeSource = qmSourceOf(this)
  var runtimeJava = qmJavaOf(this)
  if (!runtimeSource || !runtimeJava) throw new Error('七猫运行上下文缺少 source/java')
  var token = String(runtimeSource.get('qm_token') || '')
  var exp = Number(runtimeSource.get('qm_exp') || 0)
  if (!force && token && exp > Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 60) return token
  var form = {cancell_check:'1', gender:'0'}
  form.sign = qmUrlSign(form)
  var headers = qmHeaders.call(this, '')
  headers['content-type'] = 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
  var option = {method:'POST', headers:headers, body:qmForm(form)}
  var response = qmParse(runtimeJava.ajax('https://xiaoshuo.wtzw.com/api/v1/login/tourist,' + JSON.stringify(option)))
  token = String(response.data && response.data.token || '')
  if (!token) throw new Error('七猫游客登录失败')
  var jwt = qmParseJwt(token)
  var user = jwt.user || {}
  runtimeSource.put('qm_token', token)
  runtimeSource.put('qm_exp', String(jwt.exp || Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600))
  runtimeSource.put('qm_uid', String(user.uid || response.data.id || ''))
  if (user.deviceId) {
    var device = qmDevice.call(this)
    device.device_id = String(user.deviceId)
    runtimeSource.put('qm_device', JSON.stringify(device))
  }
  return token
}

function qmRequest(method, url, params, form) {
  var runtimeJava = qmJavaOf(this)
  if (!runtimeJava) throw new Error('七猫运行上下文缺少 java')
  var token = qmLogin.call(this, false)
  params = params || {}
  var fullUrl = url
  var option = {method:method, headers:qmHeaders.call(this, token)}
  if (form) {
    var body = {}
    Object.keys(form).forEach(function (key) { body[key] = String(form[key]) })
    body.sign = qmUrlSign(body)
    option.headers['content-type'] = 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
    option.body = qmForm(body)
  } else {
    var query = {}
    Object.keys(params).forEach(function (key) { query[key] = String(params[key]) })
    var parts = Object.keys(query).sort().map(function (key) { return encodeURIComponent(key) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(query[key]) })
    parts.push('sign=' + qmUrlSign(query))
    fullUrl += '?' + parts.join('&')
  }
  return qmParse(runtimeJava.ajax(fullUrl + ',' + JSON.stringify(option)))
}

function qmDecryptChapterBytes(value) {
  var raw = Packages.android.util.Base64.decode(String(value), 0)
  if (!raw || raw.length <= 16) throw new Error('七猫章节密文无效')
  var iv = Packages.java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(raw, 0, 16)
  var encrypted = Packages.java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(raw, 16, raw.length)
  var key = new Packages.javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec(new Packages.java.lang.String(QM_AES_KEY).getBytes('UTF-8'), 'AES')
  var ivSpec = new Packages.javax.crypto.spec.IvParameterSpec(iv)
  var cipher = Packages.javax.crypto.Cipher.getInstance('AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding')
  cipher.init(2, key, ivSpec)
  return cipher.doFinal(encrypted)
}

function qmDecodeTextBytes(bytes) {
  if (!bytes) return ''
  var charset = 'UTF-8'
  try {
    var headSize = Math.min(Number(bytes.length || 0), 512)
    var head = String(new Packages.java.lang.String(bytes, 0, headSize, 'ISO-8859-1'))
    var match = head.match(/(?:encoding|charset)\s*=\s*["']?\s*([A-Za-z0-9._-]+)/i)
    if (match && match[1]) charset = String(match[1])
    var b0 = Number(bytes[0]) & 255
    var b1 = Number(bytes[1]) & 255
    if (b0 == 255 && b1 == 254) charset = 'UTF-16LE'
    else if (b0 == 254 && b1 == 255) charset = 'UTF-16BE'
  } catch (detectError) {}
  try {
    return String(new Packages.java.lang.String(bytes, charset)).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')
  } catch (charsetError) {
    return String(new Packages.java.lang.String(bytes, 'UTF-8')).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')
  }
}

function qmDecryptChapter(value) {
  var bytes = qmDecryptChapterBytes(value)
  if (bytes.length > 3 && (Number(bytes[0]) & 255) == 80 && (Number(bytes[1]) & 255) == 75) {
    throw new Error('EPUB 已改为服务器解密，请配置服务地址并刷新书籍目录')
  }
  return qmDecodeTextBytes(bytes)
}

function qmEpubRemoteDecrypt(value) {
  var runtimeJava = qmJavaOf(this)
  if (!runtimeJava || !qmCallable(runtimeJava, 'ajax')) throw new Error('阅读端缺少网络请求能力')
  value = String(value || '')
  if (!value) throw new Error('七猫 EPUB 章节密文为空')
  var headers = {'content-type':'application/json; charset=utf-8','accept':'text/plain'}
  var token = qmLoginValue.call(this, '◎ EPUB服务密钥', '').trim()
  if (!token) throw new Error('请填写EPUB服务密钥')
  headers['X-Qimao-Token'] = token
  var option = {method:'POST',headers:headers,body:JSON.stringify({content:value})}
  var text = String(runtimeJava.ajax(qmEpubServiceBase.call(this) + '/decrypt,' + JSON.stringify(option)) || '').trim()
  if (!text) throw new Error('EPUB 解密服务返回空正文')
  if (/^(decrypt failed|unauthorized|not found|request body)/i.test(text)) throw new Error('EPUB 解密服务：' + text)
  return text
}

  if (mode == 'audio') return qmGetUrl.call(this, 'https://api-bc.wtzw.com/api/v2/album/detail', {album_id:id})
  return qmGetUrl.call(this, 'https://api-bc.wtzw.com/api/v1/reader/detail', {ab_type:'2',id:id})
}

function qmLocalUrlMarker(url, key, value) {
  url = String(url || '')
  var comma = url.indexOf(',')
  if (comma < 0) return url
  try {
    var option = JSON.parse(url.slice(comma + 1))
    option[String(key)] = String(value)
    return url.slice(0, comma + 1) + JSON.stringify(option)
  } catch (e) { return url }
}

function qmSearchUrl(key, page) {
  key = String(key || '').trim()
  page = String(Number(page || 1) || 1)
  var mode = 'novel'
  if (/^[nN]/.test(key)) key = key.slice(1).trim()
  else if (/^[vV]/.test(key)) { mode = 'video'; key = key.slice(1).trim() }
  else if (/^[aA]/.test(key)) { mode = 'audio'; key = key.slice(1).trim() }
  if (mode == 'video') {
    return qmGetUrl.call(this, 'https://api-bc.wtzw.com/search/v1/playlet', {
      wd:key,read_preference:'4',page:page,track_id:qmDevice.call(this).source_uid + Date.now()
    })
  }
  if (mode == 'audio' && /^\d+$/.test(key)) {
    return qmGetUrl.call(this, 'https://api-bc.wtzw.com/api/v2/album/detail', {album_id:key})
  }
  return qmGetUrl.call(this, 'https://api-bc.wtzw.com/search/v1/words', {
    extend:'',tab:mode == 'audio' ? '1' : '3',gender:'0',refresh_state:'8',
    track_id:qmDevice.call(this).source_uid + Date.now(),page:page,book_id:'',book_privacy:'1',
    wd:key,read_preference:'4',is_short_story_user:'0'
  })
}

function qmIsCandidate(x, mode) {
  x = x || {}
  if (!qmItemId(x, mode) || !(x.title || x.original_title)) return false
  if (mode == 'audio') {
    return !!(x.album_id || x.data_type == 'album' || x.data_type == 'audio' ||
      x.audio_num || x.chapter_list_desc || x.actors || x.thumb_image_link)

  if (mode == 'video') {

      x.total_num || x.play_num || x.video_url || x.play_list)

  return !!(x.data_type == 'book' || x.book_type != null || x.reader_type != null ||
    x.author || x.original_author || x.latest_chapter_id || x.latest_chapter_title || x.words_num)

function qmNormalizeBook(x, mode, contentMode) {
  var ctx = this

  if (!qmIsCandidate(x, mode)) return null
  if (mode == 'audio') {
    var aid = qmItemId(x, mode)
    return {title:x.original_title || qmPlainText(x.title),author:x.original_author || qmPlainText(x.author || x.actors) || '七猫听书',
      cover:x.image_link || x.thumb_image_link,intro:qmPlainText(x.intro || x.sub_title),kind:'听书',
      last_chapter:x.chapter_list_desc || x.audio_num || '',word_count:x.audio_num || '',
      url:qmBookRequest.call(ctx,'audio',aid,'0')}
  }
  if (mode == 'video') {
    var vid = qmItemId(x, mode)
    qmRememberVideoMeta.call(ctx, x)
    var videoType = String(x.content_type || '') == '2' ? '漫剧' : '短剧'
    return {title:x.original_title || qmPlainText(x.title),author:'七猫' + videoType,cover:x.image_link,
      intro:qmPlainText(qmVideoIntro(x, {})),kind:videoType,last_chapter:x.total_num || '',word_count:x.play_num || '',
      url:qmBookRequest.call(ctx,'video',vid,'0')}
  }
  var id = qmItemId(x, mode)
  var detailUrl = qmBookRequest.call(ctx,'novel',id,String(x.reader_type || '0'))
  detailUrl = qmLocalUrlMarker(detailUrl, 'qm_content_mode', contentMode == 'publish' ? 'publish' : 'novel')
  return {title:x.original_title || qmPlainText(x.title),author:x.original_author || qmPlainText(x.author),cover:x.image_link,
    intro:qmPlainText(x.intro || x.read_reason),kind:x.ptags || x.sub_title || x.tags,
    last_chapter:x.latest_chapter_title || x.latest_chapter_id || '',word_count:x.words_num || x.sub_title || '',
    url:detailUrl}
}

function qmSearchBooks(text, baseUrl) {
  var ctx = this
  var runtimeJava = qmJavaOf(ctx)

  var data = payload.data || {}
  var list = []
  if (data.book && data.book.album_id) list = [qmNormalizeBook.call(ctx, data.book, 'audio')]

    var mode = String(baseUrl).indexOf('/playlet') >= 0 ? 'video' : (qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'tab') == '1' ? 'audio' : 'novel')

      var keyword = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'wd')
      var currentPage = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'page') || '1'
      if (keyword) {
        try { books = (qmParse(runtimeJava.ajax(qmLegacySearchUrl.call(ctx, keyword, currentPage))).data || {}).books || [] } catch (e) {}
      }
    }

  Object.keys(state.pages || {}).sort(function (a, b) { return Number(a) - Number(b) }).forEach(function (key) {
    if (Number(key) < Number(page)) ids = ids.concat(state.pages[key] || [])
  })

  return ids.filter(function (id) { id = String(id); if (!id || seen[id]) return false; seen[id] = 1; return true }).slice(-120).map(function (id) {

function qmRememberVideoPage(kind, page, items) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  if (!runtimeCache) return items
  page = String(Number(page || 1) || 1)
  var state = qmVideoState.call(this, kind)
  var prior = {}
  Object.keys(state.pages || {}).forEach(function (key) {
    if (key != page) (state.pages[key] || []).forEach(function (id) { prior[String(id)] = 1 })
  })
  var current = []
  var local = {}
  var filtered = items.filter(function (item) {
    var id = qmItemId(item, 'video')
    if (!id || local[id] || prior[id]) return false
    local[id] = 1
    current.push(String(id))
    return true
  })
  state.pages[page] = current
  Object.keys(state.pages).forEach(function (key) { if (Number(key) < Number(page) - 8) delete state.pages[key] })
  runtimeCache.putMemory('qm-video-pages-' + kind, JSON.stringify(state))

function qmCommentPageData(input) {
  try {
    input = input || {}
    var ctx = this
    var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
    var kind = String(input.kind || 'paragraph')
    var cursor = String(input.cursor || '')
    var response
    var data
    var list = []
    var tags = []
    var total = ''
    var next = ''
    if (kind == 'book') {
      var bookId = String(input.bookId || '')
      var bookHot = String(input.hot || '0') == '1'
      var bp = {circle_id:bookId,need_common:'0',tag_id:String(input.tag || '1'),book_id:bookId,sort:bookHot ? '0' : '1'}
      if (cursor) bp.next_id = cursor
      response = qmGet.call(ctx, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/community/book-evaluates', bp)
      data = response.data || {}
      list = (data.list || []).map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, bookHot, false) })
      var evaluateInfo = data.evaluates_info || {}
      if (!cursor) total = String(evaluateInfo.eval_comment_count || data.comment_count || list.length)
      next = String(data.next_id || '')
      tags = (evaluateInfo.tag_list || data.tag_list || []).map(function (x) { return {id:String(x.id || x.tag_id || '1'),title:String(x.title || x.name || '全部'),count:String(x.count || x.comment_count || '')} })
    } else {

      var params = {book_id:String(input.bookId || ''),chapter_id:String(input.chapterId || '')}
      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.paragraph_id = String(input.paragraphId || '')
      params.hot = hot
      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.check_cmt_id = String(input.checkId || '')
      var firstUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/first' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/first'
      var moreUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/more' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/more'
      if (cursor) {
        params.next_id = cursor
        response = qmGet.call(ctx, moreUrl, params)
      } else {
        params.exposed_ids = ''
        params.need_common = hot == '1' ? '1' : '0'
        if (kind == 'chapter') params.extra = ''
        response = qmPostForm.call(ctx, firstUrl, params)
      }
      data = response.data || {}
      if (cursor) {
        list = (data.comment_list || []).map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, false) })
        next = String(data.next_id || '')
      } else {

  cached = cached || {}
  var text = raw.intro || raw.description || raw.desc || raw.summary || raw.story_intro || cached.intro || ''
  if (text) return String(text)
  var total = raw.total_num || raw.latest_num || cached.total_num || ''
  var type = String(raw.content_type || cached.content_type || '') == '2' ? '漫剧' : '短剧'
  return '七猫官方' + type + (total ? '，共 ' + total + ' 集。' : '。')
}

function qmNormalizeBook(x, mode, contentMode) {
  var ctx = this
  x = x || {}
  if (!qmIsCandidate(x, mode)) return null
  if (mode == 'audio') {
    var aid = qmItemId(x, mode)
    return {title:x.original_title || qmPlainText(x.title),author:x.original_author || qmPlainText(x.author || x.actors) || '七猫听书',
      cover:x.image_link || x.thumb_image_link,intro:qmPlainText(x.intro || x.sub_title),kind:'听书',
      last_chapter:x.chapter_list_desc || x.audio_num || '',word_count:x.audio_num || '',
      url:qmBookRequest.call(ctx,'audio',aid,'0')}
  }
  if (mode == 'video') {
    var vid = qmItemId(x, mode)
    qmRememberVideoMeta.call(ctx, x)
    var videoType = String(x.content_type || '') == '2' ? '漫剧' : '短剧'
    return {title:x.original_title || qmPlainText(x.title),author:'七猫' + videoType,cover:x.image_link,
      intro:qmPlainText(qmVideoIntro(x, {})),kind:videoType,last_chapter:x.total_num || '',word_count:x.play_num || '',
      url:qmBookRequest.call(ctx,'video',vid,'0')}
  }
  var id = qmItemId(x, mode)
  var detailUrl = qmBookRequest.call(ctx,'novel',id,String(x.reader_type || '0'))
  detailUrl = qmLocalUrlMarker(detailUrl, 'qm_content_mode', contentMode == 'publish' ? 'publish' : 'novel')
  return {title:x.original_title || qmPlainText(x.title),author:x.original_author || qmPlainText(x.author),cover:x.image_link,
    intro:qmPlainText(x.intro || x.read_reason),kind:x.ptags || x.sub_title || x.tags,
    last_chapter:x.latest_chapter_title || x.latest_chapter_id || '',word_count:x.words_num || x.sub_title || '',
    url:detailUrl}
}

function qmSearchBooks(text, baseUrl) {
  var ctx = this
  var runtimeJava = qmJavaOf(ctx)
  var payload = qmParse(text)
  var data = payload.data || {}
  var list = []
  if (data.book && data.book.album_id) list = [qmNormalizeBook.call(ctx, data.book, 'audio')]
  else {
    var mode = String(baseUrl).indexOf('/playlet') >= 0 ? 'video' : (qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'tab') == '1' ? 'audio' : 'novel')
    var books = data.books || []
    if (!books.length && mode == 'novel' && String(baseUrl).indexOf('/search/v1/words') >= 0) {
      var keyword = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'wd')
      var currentPage = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'page') || '1'
      if (keyword) {
        try { books = (qmParse(runtimeJava.ajax(qmLegacySearchUrl.call(ctx, keyword, currentPage))).data || {}).books || [] } catch (e) {}
      }
    }
    list = books.map(function (x) {
      var itemMode = mode
      if (x.album_id || x.data_type == 'album' || x.data_type == 'audio') itemMode = 'audio'
      return qmNormalizeBook.call(ctx, x, itemMode)
    }).filter(function (x) { return !!x && !!x.title && !!x.url })
  }
  return JSON.stringify({data:list})
}

function qmVideoState(kind) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  if (!runtimeCache) return {pages:{}}
  try {
    var saved = runtimeCache.getFromMemory('qm-video-pages-' + kind)
    var state = saved ? JSON.parse(String(saved)) : null
    if (state && state.pages) return state
  } catch (e) {}
  return {pages:{}}
}

function qmResetVideoState(kind) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  try { if (runtimeCache) runtimeCache.deleteMemory('qm-video-pages-' + kind) } catch (e) {}
}

function qmVideoUploadIds(kind, page) {
  page = String(Number(page || 1) || 1)
  if (page == '1') {
    qmResetVideoState.call(this, kind)
    return []
  }
  var state = qmVideoState.call(this, kind)
  var ids = []
  Object.keys(state.pages || {}).sort(function (a, b) { return Number(a) - Number(b) }).forEach(function (key) {
    if (Number(key) < Number(page)) ids = ids.concat(state.pages[key] || [])
  })
  var seen = {}
  return ids.filter(function (id) { id = String(id); if (!id || seen[id]) return false; seen[id] = 1; return true }).slice(-120).map(function (id) {
    return {id:String(id),item_type:kind == 'animated' ? '14' : '11',ts:String(Date.now()),type:'0'}
  })
}

function qmRememberVideoPage(kind, page, items) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  if (!runtimeCache) return items
  page = String(Number(page || 1) || 1)
  var state = qmVideoState.call(this, kind)
  var prior = {}
  Object.keys(state.pages || {}).forEach(function (key) {
    if (key != page) (state.pages[key] || []).forEach(function (id) { prior[String(id)] = 1 })
  })
  var current = []
  var local = {}
  var filtered = items.filter(function (item) {
    var id = qmItemId(item, 'video')
    if (!id || local[id] || prior[id]) return false
    local[id] = 1
    current.push(String(id))
    return true
  })
  state.pages[page] = current
  Object.keys(state.pages).forEach(function (key) { if (Number(key) < Number(page) - 8) delete state.pages[key] })
  runtimeCache.putMemory('qm-video-pages-' + kind, JSON.stringify(state))
  return filtered
}

function qmExploreMarker(url, kind, page) {
  var comma = String(url).indexOf(',')
  if (comma < 0) comma = String(url).length
  return String(url).slice(0, comma) + '#qm_video=' + encodeURIComponent(kind) + '&qm_page=' + encodeURIComponent(String(page)) + String(url).slice(comma)
}

function qmCollectExplore(node, mode, output, seen, depth) {
  var ctx = this
  if (node == null || depth > 8) return
  if (Array.isArray(node)) {
    node.forEach(function (item) { qmCollectExplore.call(ctx, item, mode, output, seen, depth + 1) })
    return
  }
  if (typeof node != 'object') return
  var itemMode = mode == 'publish' ? 'novel' : mode
  var id = qmItemId(node, itemMode)
  if (id && String(id) != '0' && qmIsCandidate(node, itemMode)) {
    var key = mode + '-' + id
    if (!seen[key]) {
      seen[key] = 1
      output.push(qmNormalizeBook.call(ctx, node, itemMode, mode))
    }
  }
  Object.keys(node).forEach(function (key) {
    if (!/^(meta|stat_params|track_id|tag_items|category_list|rank_list)$/.test(key)) {
      qmCollectExplore.call(ctx, node[key], mode, output, seen, depth + 1)
    }
  })
}

function qmExploreBooks(text, selectedMode, baseUrl) {
  var ctx = this
  var data = qmParse(text).data || {}
  var mode = selectedMode || qmExploreMode.call(ctx)
  var list = []
  var seen = {}
  if (mode == 'novel') {
    list = (data.books || []).map(function (x) { return qmNormalizeBook.call(ctx, x, 'novel') })
  } else if (mode == 'video' && /\/playlet\/api\/v(1\/animated\/index|2\/list-by-tagId)/.test(String(baseUrl || ''))) {
    var kind = String(baseUrl).indexOf('/animated/index') >= 0 ? 'animated' : 'drama'
    var contentType = kind == 'animated' ? '2' : '1'
    var page = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'qm_page') || '1'
    var rawVideos = (data.playlet_list || []).filter(function (x) { return String(x.content_type || '') == contentType })
    rawVideos = qmRememberVideoPage.call(ctx, kind, page, rawVideos)
    list = rawVideos.map(function (x) { return qmNormalizeBook.call(ctx, x, 'video') })
  } else {
    qmCollectExplore.call(ctx, data, mode, list, seen, 0)
  }
  return JSON.stringify({data:list.filter(function (x) { return !!x && !!x.title && !!x.url })})
}

function qmDateText(value) {
  var seconds = Number(value || 0)
  if (!seconds) return ''
  var date = new Date(seconds > 9999999999 ? seconds : seconds * 1000)
  function two(number) { return number < 10 ? '0' + number : String(number) }
  return date.getFullYear() + '-' + two(date.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + two(date.getDate()) + ' ' + two(date.getHours()) + ':' + two(date.getMinutes())
}

function qmExtraInfoText(item) {
  item = item || {}
  if (item.value === null || item.value === undefined || String(item.value) === '') return ''
  return String(item.value) + String(item.unit || '')
}

function qmNovelInfo(raw) {
  raw = raw || {}
  var info = {}
  Object.keys(raw).forEach(function (key) { info[key] = raw[key] })
  var tags = (raw.book_tag_list || []).map(function (x) { return String(x.title || '') }).filter(function (x) { return !!x })
  var attribute = raw.attribute || {}
  var extras = attribute.extra_info_list || []
  function findExtra(pattern) {
    for (var i = 0; i < extras.length; i++) {
      if (pattern.test(String(extras[i].sub_title || extras[i].title || ''))) return qmExtraInfoText(extras[i])
    }
    return ''
  }
  var score = attribute.score || findExtra(/评分|评价/)
  if (score && String(score).indexOf('分') < 0) score = String(score) + '分'
  var reading = ''
  var readingList = attribute.reading_info_list || []
  if (readingList.length > 2) reading = qmExtraInfoText(readingList[2]) || String(readingList[2].title || readingList[2].text || '')
  if (!reading) reading = findExtra(/正在阅读|在线/)
  var lines = []
  var updated = qmDateText(raw.update_time)
  if (updated) lines.push('🧭 更新：' + updated)
  if (raw.category_over_words) lines.push('📒 关于：' + raw.category_over_words)
  if (score) lines.push('💯 分数：' + score)
  if (reading) lines.push('👁️ 在线：' + reading)
  if (tags.length) lines.push('🏷️ 标签：' + tags.join(' / '))
  if (raw.characters) lines.push('👥 角色：' + raw.characters)
  if (raw.publisher) lines.push('🏢 出版：' + raw.publisher)
  if (raw.isbn) lines.push('🔖 ISBN：' + raw.isbn)
  var copyright = raw.statement || raw.source_name
  if (copyright) lines.push('📍 版权来源：' + copyright)
  if (raw.intro) lines.push('📄 简介：' + raw.intro)
  info.id = String(raw.id || '')
  info.author = raw.author || raw.author_name || ''
  info.image_link = raw.big_image_link || raw.image_link || raw.thumb_image_link || ''
  info.intro = lines.join('\n')
  info.kind = [raw.category_over_words].concat(tags).filter(function (x) { return !!x }).join(',')
  info.last_chapter = raw.latest_chapter_title || raw.chapter_list_desc || ''
  info.words_num = raw.words_num || raw.word_count || ''
  return info
}

function qmBookInfo(text, baseUrl) {
  var ctx = this
  var runtimeBook = qmBookOf(ctx)
  var payload = qmParse(text)
  var raw = payload.data || {}
  var mode = 'novel'
  var info
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/playlet/api/info') >= 0) {
    mode = 'video'
    raw = raw.playlet || raw.playlet_info || raw
    var playletId = String(raw.playlet_id || qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'playlet_id') || '')
    var cachedVideo = qmVideoMeta.call(ctx, playletId)
    if (!raw.intro && !raw.description && !raw.desc && !raw.summary && playletId) {
      try {
        var detailData = qmGet.call(ctx, 'https://api-gw.wtzw.com/playlet/api/detail', {
          playlet_id:playletId,playlet_privacy:'1',read_preference:'0'
        }).data || {}
        Object.keys(detailData).forEach(function (key) { if (raw[key] === null || raw[key] === undefined || raw[key] === '') raw[key] = detailData[key] })
      } catch (detailError) {}
    }
    var contentType = String(raw.content_type || cachedVideo.content_type || '')
    var videoKind = contentType == '2' ? '漫剧' : '短剧'
    var videoTags = qmVideoTags(raw)
    if (!videoTags.length && cachedVideo.tags) videoTags = String(cachedVideo.tags).split(/[,/\s]+/).filter(function (x) { return !!x })
    var creator = typeof raw.creator == 'object' && raw.creator ? raw.creator.nickname || raw.creator.name || '' : raw.creator || ''
    info = {id:playletId,title:raw.title || cachedVideo.title,author:creator || '七猫' + videoKind,image_link:raw.image_link,
      intro:'🎬 剧情：' + qmVideoIntro(raw, cachedVideo),kind:[videoKind].concat(videoTags).join(','),
      last_chapter:'共 ' + String(raw.total_num || cachedVideo.total_num || 0) + ' 集',words_num:String(raw.play_num || ''),
      toc_url:qmGetUrl.call(ctx, 'https://api-gw.wtzw.com/playlet/api/info',{playlet_id:playletId})}
    qmRememberVideoMeta.call(ctx, {playlet_id:playletId,title:info.title,intro:info.intro.replace(/^🎬 剧情：/,''),tags:videoTags.join(','),content_type:contentType,total_num:raw.total_num || cachedVideo.total_num})
    try { if (runtimeBook) runtimeBook.type = 4 } catch (e) {}
  } else if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/album/detail') >= 0) {
    mode = 'audio'
    raw = raw.book || {}
    info = {id:String(raw.album_id || ''),title:raw.title,author:raw.author || raw.actors,image_link:raw.image_link || raw.thumb_image_link,
      intro:raw.intro,kind:(raw.book_tag_list || []).map(function (x) { return x.title }).join(','),
      last_chapter:raw.chapter_list_desc,toc_url:qmGetUrl.call(ctx, 'https://api-ks.wtzw.com/api/v1/album/chapter-list',{album_id:String(raw.album_id || ''),source:'0'})}
    try { if (runtimeBook) runtimeBook.type = 32 } catch (e) {}
  } else {
    info = qmNovelInfo(raw)
    var readerTypeValue = String(raw.reader_type || '0')
    var requestedMode = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'qm_content_mode')
    if (!requestedMode) {
      var requestedModeMatch = String(baseUrl || '').match(/["&?]qm_content_mode(?:"\s*:|=)"?([^",&#}]+)/)
      if (requestedModeMatch) requestedMode = String(requestedModeMatch[1] || '')
    }
    mode = requestedMode == 'publish' || readerTypeValue != '0' || raw.publisher || raw.isbn ? 'publish' : 'novel'
    info.reader_type = readerTypeValue
    info.toc_url = qmGetUrl.call(ctx, 'https://api-ks.wtzw.com/api/v1/chapter/chapter-list', {
      id:String(raw.id || ''),chapter_ver:'0',reader_type:readerTypeValue
    })
    try {
      if (runtimeBook) {
        runtimeBook.type = 8
        if (runtimeBook.putVariable) runtimeBook.putVariable('qm_reader_type', readerTypeValue)
        if (runtimeBook.putVariable) runtimeBook.putVariable('qm_content_mode', mode)
      }
    } catch (e) {}
  }
  if (mode == 'novel' && info.id && qmCommentsAllowed(ctx, baseUrl) && qmCommentConfig.call(ctx).book) {
    try { info.intro = String(info.intro || '') + qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'book', String(info.id), '', '', qmBookReviewCount.call(ctx, String(info.id)), '本书书评') } catch (e) {}
  }
  info.mode = mode
  return {data:info}
}

function qmToc(text, baseUrl) {
  var ctx = this
  var runtimeBook = qmBookOf(ctx)
  var payload = qmParse(text)
  var data = payload.data || {}
  var list = []
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/playlet/api/info') >= 0) {
    try { if (runtimeBook) runtimeBook.type = 4 } catch (e) {}
    list = (data.play_list || []).filter(function (x) { return !!(x.video_url || x.video_url_h265) }).map(function (x, index) {
      var sort = x.sort === null || x.sort === undefined ? index + 1 : x.sort
      var playUrl = String(x.video_url || x.video_url_h265 || '')
      var url = qmDataUrl(ctx, playUrl, 'video', {playlet_id:String(data.playlet_id || ''),qm_sort:String(sort)})
      return {title:'第' + sort + '集',info:'时长 ' + (x.duration || '-') + ' 秒 · 评论 ' + (x.comment_count || 0),url:url}
    })
  } else if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/album/chapter-list') >= 0) {
    try { if (runtimeBook) runtimeBook.type = 32 } catch (e2) {}
    var aid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'album_id')
    var chapters = data.chapter_list || data.list || data.chapters || []
    list = chapters.map(function (x, index) {
      var chapterId = x.id || x.chapter_id
      return {title:x.title || x.chapter_title || ('第' + (x.index || index + 1) + '集'),info:'时长 ' + (x.duration || '-') + ' 秒',url:qmGetUrl.call(ctx, 'https://api-ks.wtzw.com/api/v1/album/info', {
        album_id:aid,chapter_id:String(chapterId),new_user:'0'
      })}
    })
  } else {
    var bid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'id')
    var readerType = String(data.reader_type || qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'reader_type') || '0')
    var contentMode = qmBookVariable(ctx, 'qm_content_mode') || (readerType == '0' ? 'novel' : 'publish')
    try {
      if (runtimeBook) {
        runtimeBook.type = 8
        if (runtimeBook.putVariable) runtimeBook.putVariable('qm_reader_type', readerType)
      }
    } catch (e3) {}
    list = (data.chapter_lists || []).map(function (x) {
      var params = {id:bid,chapterId:String(x.id)}
      if (readerType == '4') params.reader_agent = '1'
      var chapterUrl = qmGetUrl.call(ctx, 'https://api-ks.wtzw.com/api/v1/chapter/content',params)
      var comma = chapterUrl.indexOf(',')
      if (comma >= 0) {
        try {
          var option = JSON.parse(chapterUrl.slice(comma + 1))
          option.qm_reader_type = readerType
          option.qm_content_mode = contentMode
          chapterUrl = chapterUrl.slice(0, comma + 1) + JSON.stringify(option)
        } catch (optionError) {}
      }
      return {title:x.title,info:'字数 ' + (x.words || '-'),url:chapterUrl}
    })
  }
  return list
}

function qmEsc(value) {
  return String(value == null ? '' : value).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
    return {'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c]
  })
}

function qmEmojiData(input) {
  input = input || {}
  var tokens = input.tokens || []
  if (!Array.isArray(tokens)) tokens = [tokens]
  var result = {}
  tokens.slice(0, 6).forEach(function (token) {
    token = String(token || '')
    if (QM_EMOJI_DATA[token]) result[token] = QM_EMOJI_DATA[token]
  })
  return JSON.stringify(result)
}

function qmCommentItem(item, hot, allowUnknownReplies) {
  item = item || {}
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(this)
  var user = item.user_info || item.user || {}
  var medal = user.on_medal || item.on_medal || {}
  var badgeInfo = user.badge_info || item.badge_info || {}
  var honorInfo = user.honor_info || item.honor_info || {}
  var levelValue = user.level != null ? user.level : (item.level != null ? item.level : '')
  var levelNumber = Number(levelValue || 0)
  var levelIcon = String(user.level_icon || item.level_icon || '')
  if (!levelIcon && levelNumber > 0) levelIcon = 'https://cdn.wtzw.com/bookimg/free/images/app/1_0_0/level/level_icon_' + levelNumber + '.png'
  var circleLevel = badgeInfo.circle_level != null ? badgeInfo.circle_level : (item.circle_level != null ? item.circle_level : '')
  var circleNumber = Number(circleLevel || 0)

}

function qmCommentPageData(input) {
  try {
    input = input || {}
    var ctx = this
    var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
    var kind = String(input.kind || 'paragraph')
    var cursor = String(input.cursor || '')
    var response
    var data
    var list = []
    var tags = []
    var total = ''
    var next = ''
    if (kind == 'book') {
      var bookId = String(input.bookId || '')
      var bookHot = String(input.hot || '0') == '1'
      var bp = {circle_id:bookId,need_common:'0',tag_id:String(input.tag || '1'),book_id:bookId,sort:bookHot ? '0' : '1'}
      if (cursor) bp.next_id = cursor
      response = qmGet.call(ctx, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/community/book-evaluates', bp)
      data = response.data || {}
      list = (data.list || []).map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, bookHot, false) })
      var evaluateInfo = data.evaluates_info || {}
      if (!cursor) total = String(evaluateInfo.eval_comment_count || data.comment_count || list.length)
      next = String(data.next_id || '')
      tags = (evaluateInfo.tag_list || data.tag_list || []).map(function (x) { return {id:String(x.id || x.tag_id || '1'),title:String(x.title || x.name || '全部'),count:String(x.count || x.comment_count || '')} })
    } else {
      var hot = String(input.hot || '0') == '1' ? '1' : '0'
      var params = {book_id:String(input.bookId || ''),chapter_id:String(input.chapterId || '')}
      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.paragraph_id = String(input.paragraphId || '')
      params.hot = hot
      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.check_cmt_id = String(input.checkId || '')
      var firstUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/first' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/first'
      var moreUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/more' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/more'
      if (cursor) {
        params.next_id = cursor
        response = qmGet.call(ctx, moreUrl, params)
      } else {
        params.exposed_ids = ''
        params.need_common = hot == '1' ? '1' : '0'
        if (kind == 'chapter') params.extra = ''
        response = qmPostForm.call(ctx, firstUrl, params)
      }
      data = response.data || {}
      if (cursor) {
        list = (data.comment_list || []).map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, false) })
        next = String(data.next_id || '')
      } else {
        var hotZone = data.hot_zone || {}

        var hotList = hotZone.comment_list || []
        var timeList = timeZone.comment_list || []

function qmReplyPageData(input) {

function qmSvg(kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot) {
  var normalizedKind = String(kind || '')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(this)
  var color = cfg.color
  count = Number(count || 0)
  if (count <= 0) return ''
  if (normalizedKind == 'paragraph' && cfg.split) color = hot ? cfg.hotColor : count >= cfg.splitCount ? cfg.splitColor : cfg.color
  count = Math.min(count, 999)
  var svg
  if (normalizedKind == 'paragraph') {
    var displayText = String(Math.min(count, 999))
    var custom = cfg.template == '起点' ? '' : qmLoginValue.call(this, cfg.template.replace('样式', '◎ 气泡'), '')
    svg = custom.trim() ? custom.replace(/\$\{qpyscolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{qpwzcolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{font\}/g, 'Arial').replace(/\$\{displayText\}/g, displayText) :
      '<svg viewBox="5 14 45 36" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="180" height="144"><path d="M44 48 Q48 48 48 44 L48 20 Q48 16 44 16 L20 16 Q16 16 16 20 L16 24 S16 28 10 30 Q6 32 10 34 Q16 36 16 38 L16 44 Q16 48 20 48 Z" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="0.7"/><text x="32" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-weight="600" font-size="18" fill="' + color + '" dominant-baseline="middle">' + displayText + '</text></svg>'
  } else if (normalizedKind == 'book' || normalizedKind == 'chapter') {
    svg = '<svg width="1000" height="128" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="6" y="6" width="988" height="116" rx="12" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="3"/><text x="48" y="79" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="38" fill="' + color + '">' + qmEsc(label) + '</text><text x="950" y="79" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial" font-size="34" fill="' + color + '">' + count + ' 条 ›</text></svg>'
  } else {
    svg = '<svg width="1000" height="800" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="150" y="150" width="665" height="525" rx="175" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="18"/><text x="480" y="535" font-family="Arial" text-anchor="middle" font-size="298" fill="' + color + '">' + count + '</text></svg>'
  }
  var encoded = qmBase64Encode(this, svg)
  if (!encoded) return ''
  var call = 'qmOpenComment.call(this,' + [normalizedKind, bid, cid, pid, label || '', checkId || ''].map(function (x) { return JSON.stringify(String(x || '')) }).join(',') + ')'
  var style = normalizedKind == 'paragraph' ? qmCommentConfig.call(this).svgSize : 'FULL'
  return 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + encoded + ',' + JSON.stringify({style:style,type:'qmpl',click:call})
}

function qmChapterReviewCount(bid, cid) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  var key = 'qm-count-chapter-' + bid + '-' + cid
  var saved = runtimeCache && runtimeCache.getFromMemory(key)
  if (saved != null) return Number(saved || 0)
  var data = qmGet.call(this, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/comment/chapter-end-comment', {book_id:bid,chapter_ids:cid}).data || {}
  var comments = data.comments || []
  var count = comments.length ? Number(comments[0].count || 0) : 0
  if (runtimeCache) runtimeCache.putMemory(key, String(count))
  return count
}

function qmBookReviewCount(bid) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  var key = 'qm-count-book-' + bid
  var saved = runtimeCache && runtimeCache.getFromMemory(key)
  if (saved != null) return Number(saved || 0)
  var data = qmGet.call(this, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/community/book-evaluates', {circle_id:bid,need_common:'0',tag_id:'1',book_id:bid,sort:'0'}).data || {}
  var count = Number(data.evaluates_info && data.evaluates_info.eval_comment_count || data.comment_count || 0)
  if (runtimeCache) runtimeCache.putMemory(key, String(count))
  return count

function qmNovelContent(text, baseUrl) {
  var ctx = this
  var raw = qmParse(text).data || {}
  var bid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'id')
  var cid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'chapterId')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
  var readerType = qmReaderType(ctx, baseUrl)
  var content = readerType == '3' ? qmEpubRemoteDecrypt.call(ctx, raw.content || '') : qmDecryptChapter(raw.content || '')
  if (!qmCommentsAllowed(ctx, baseUrl)) return content
  var marks = {}
  if (cfg.paragraph || cfg.god) {
    try {
      var bubbleResponse = qmPostForm.call(ctx, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/paragraph/bubbles', {
        book_id:bid,chapters:JSON.stringify([{chapter_id:cid,chapter_md5:String(raw.content_md5 || '')}])
      })
      var chapters = bubbleResponse.data && bubbleResponse.data.chapters || []
      var bubbles = chapters.length ? chapters[0].bubbles || [] : []
      bubbles.forEach(function (item) {
        var count = Number(item.c || 0)
        if (count > 0 || item.gid || item.gtxt) marks[String(item.p)] = {count:count,hot:String(item.hot || '') == '1',gid:String(item.gid || ''),gtxt:String(item.gtxt || '')}
      })
    } catch (bubbleError) {}
  }
  var lines = String(content).split('\n')
  lines.forEach(function (line, index) {
    var pid = qmMd5(line).slice(0, 8)
    var mark = marks[pid]
    if (!mark || !line) return
    var bubble = cfg.paragraph ? qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'paragraph', bid, cid, pid, mark.count, mark.hot ? '热门段评' : '七猫段评', mark.gid, mark.hot) : ''
    if (bubble) lines[index] += bubble
    var god = cfg.god ? qmGodImage.call(ctx, bid, cid, pid, mark.gid, mark.gtxt) : ''
    if (god) lines[index] += '\n' + god
  })
  if (cfg.chapter) try { var chapterBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'chapter', bid, cid, '', qmChapterReviewCount.call(ctx, bid, cid), '本章说'); if (chapterBubble) lines.push(chapterBubble) } catch (chapterError) {}
  if (cfg.book) try { var bookBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'book', bid, '', '', qmBookReviewCount.call(ctx, bid), '本书书评'); if (bookBubble) lines.push(bookBubble) } catch (bookError) {}
  return lines.join('\n')
}

function qmReadContent(text, baseUrl) {
  if (/^data:;base64,/.test(String(baseUrl)) && /["']type["']\s*:\s*["']video["']/.test(String(baseUrl))) {
    return qmHexDecodeAscii(text)
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/playlet/api/info') >= 0) {
    var video = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var playList = video.play_list || []
    var sort = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'qm_sort')
    var runtimeChapter = qmChapterOf(this)
    if (!sort) {
      try {
        var titleMatch = String(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.title || '').match(/第\s*(\d+)\s*集/)
        if (titleMatch) sort = titleMatch[1]
      } catch (titleError) {}
    }
    var item = playList.filter(function (x) { return sort && String(x.sort) == String(sort) })[0]
    if (!item) {
      var chapterIndex = -1
      try { chapterIndex = Number(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.index) } catch (indexError) {}
      if (chapterIndex >= 0) item = playList[chapterIndex]
    }
    if (!item) item = playList.filter(function (x) { return !!(x.video_url || x.video_url_h265) })[0] || {}
    return String(item.video_url || item.video_url_h265 || '')
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/album/info') >= 0) {
    var audio = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var voices = audio.voice_list || []
    return voices.length ? String(voices[0].voice_url) : '本集暂无可播放音频'
  }
  return qmNovelContent.call(this, text, baseUrl)
}

  })

function qmRememberVideoPage(kind, page, items) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  if (!runtimeCache) return items
  page = String(Number(page || 1) || 1)
  var state = qmVideoState.call(this, kind)
  var prior = {}
  Object.keys(state.pages || {}).forEach(function (key) {
    if (key != page) (state.pages[key] || []).forEach(function (id) { prior[String(id)] = 1 })
  })
  var current = []
  var local = {}
  var filtered = items.filter(function (item) {
    var id = qmItemId(item, 'video')
    if (!id || local[id] || prior[id]) return false
    local[id] = 1
    current.push(String(id))
    return true
  })
  state.pages[page] = current
  Object.keys(state.pages).forEach(function (key) { if (Number(key) < Number(page) - 8) delete state.pages[key] })
  runtimeCache.putMemory('qm-video-pages-' + kind, JSON.stringify(state))
  return filtered
}

function qmCollectExplore(node, mode, output, seen, depth) {
  var ctx = this

    return
  }
  if (typeof node != 'object') return
  var itemMode = mode == 'publish' ? 'novel' : mode
  var id = qmItemId(node, itemMode)
  if (id && String(id) != '0' && qmIsCandidate(node, itemMode)) {
    var key = mode + '-' + id
    if (!seen[key]) {
      seen[key] = 1
      output.push(qmNormalizeBook.call(ctx, node, itemMode, mode))
    }
  }
  Object.keys(node).forEach(function (key) {
    if (!/^(meta|stat_params|track_id|tag_items|category_list|rank_list)$/.test(key)) {
      qmCollectExplore.call(ctx, node[key], mode, output, seen, depth + 1)
    }
  })
}

function qmDateText(value) {

  return date.getFullYear() + '-' + two(date.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + two(date.getDate()) + ' ' + two(date.getHours()) + ':' + two(date.getMinutes())
}

function qmNovelInfo(raw) {

  var attribute = raw.attribute || {}
  var extras = attribute.extra_info_list || []
  function findExtra(pattern) {
    for (var i = 0; i < extras.length; i++) {
      if (pattern.test(String(extras[i].sub_title || extras[i].title || ''))) return qmExtraInfoText(extras[i])
    }
    return ''
  }
  var score = attribute.score || findExtra(/评分|评价/)
  if (score && String(score).indexOf('分') < 0) score = String(score) + '分'
  var reading = ''
  var readingList = attribute.reading_info_list || []
  if (readingList.length > 2) reading = qmExtraInfoText(readingList[2]) || String(readingList[2].title || readingList[2].text || '')
  if (!reading) reading = findExtra(/正在阅读|在线/)
  var lines = []
  var updated = qmDateText(raw.update_time)
  if (updated) lines.push('🧭 更新：' + updated)
  if (raw.category_over_words) lines.push('📒 关于：' + raw.category_over_words)
  if (score) lines.push('💯 分数：' + score)
  if (reading) lines.push('👁️ 在线：' + reading)
  if (tags.length) lines.push('🏷️ 标签：' + tags.join(' / '))
  if (raw.characters) lines.push('👥 角色：' + raw.characters)
  if (raw.publisher) lines.push('🏢 出版：' + raw.publisher)
  if (raw.isbn) lines.push('🔖 ISBN：' + raw.isbn)
  var copyright = raw.statement || raw.source_name
  if (copyright) lines.push('📍 版权来源：' + copyright)
  if (raw.intro) lines.push('📄 简介：' + raw.intro)
  info.id = String(raw.id || '')
  info.author = raw.author || raw.author_name || ''
  info.image_link = raw.big_image_link || raw.image_link || raw.thumb_image_link || ''
  info.intro = lines.join('\n')
  info.kind = [raw.category_over_words].concat(tags).filter(function (x) { return !!x }).join(',')
  info.last_chapter = raw.latest_chapter_title || raw.chapter_list_desc || ''

  return info

function qmCommentPageData(input) {
  try {
    input = input || {}
    var ctx = this
    var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
    var kind = String(input.kind || 'paragraph')
    var cursor = String(input.cursor || '')
    var response
    var data
    var list = []
    var tags = []
    var total = ''
    var next = ''
    if (kind == 'book') {
      var bookId = String(input.bookId || '')
      var bookHot = String(input.hot || '0') == '1'
      var bp = {circle_id:bookId,need_common:'0',tag_id:String(input.tag || '1'),book_id:bookId,sort:bookHot ? '0' : '1'}
      if (cursor) bp.next_id = cursor
      response = qmGet.call(ctx, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/community/book-evaluates', bp)
      data = response.data || {}
      list = (data.list || []).map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, bookHot, false) })
      var evaluateInfo = data.evaluates_info || {}
      if (!cursor) total = String(evaluateInfo.eval_comment_count || data.comment_count || list.length)
      next = String(data.next_id || '')
      tags = (evaluateInfo.tag_list || data.tag_list || []).map(function (x) { return {id:String(x.id || x.tag_id || '1'),title:String(x.title || x.name || '全部'),count:String(x.count || x.comment_count || '')} })
    } else {
      var hot = String(input.hot || '0') == '1' ? '1' : '0'
      var params = {book_id:String(input.bookId || ''),chapter_id:String(input.chapterId || '')}
      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.paragraph_id = String(input.paragraphId || '')
      params.hot = hot
      if (kind == 'paragraph') params.check_cmt_id = String(input.checkId || '')
      var firstUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/first' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/first'
      var moreUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/more' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/more'
      if (cursor) {
        params.next_id = cursor
        response = qmGet.call(ctx, moreUrl, params)
      } else {
        params.exposed_ids = ''
        params.need_common = hot == '1' ? '1' : '0'
        if (kind == 'chapter') params.extra = ''
        response = qmPostForm.call(ctx, firstUrl, params)
      }
      data = response.data || {}
      if (cursor) {
        list = (data.comment_list || []).map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, false) })
        next = String(data.next_id || '')
      } else {
        var hotZone = data.hot_zone || {}
        var timeZone = data.time_zone || {}
        var hotList = hotZone.comment_list || []
        var timeList = timeZone.comment_list || []
        list = hotList.map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, true) })
          .concat(timeList.map(function (x) { return qmCommentItem.call(ctx, x, false) }))

function qmOpenComment(kind, bid, cid, pid, heading, checkId) {
  var html = qmCommentHtml.call(this, kind, bid, cid, pid, heading, checkId)
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(this)
  var runtimeJava = qmJavaOf(this)
  if (!qmCallable(runtimeJava, 'showBrowser')) return false
  runtimeJava.showBrowser('https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/', html, 'window.java=java;window.cache=cache;window.source=source;window.qmRun=run;window.qmLocalCommentPage=true;', JSON.stringify({state:4,isHideable:true,heightPercentage:cfg.height,widthPercentage:1.0,dismissOnTouchOutside:true,skipCollapsed:true,expandedCornersRadius:16,isGestureInsetBottomIgnored:true,hardwareAccelerated:true,webViewInitialScale:100}))
  return true
}

function qmSvg(kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot) {
  var normalizedKind = String(kind || '')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(this)
  var color = cfg.color
  count = Number(count || 0)
  if (count <= 0) return ''
  if (normalizedKind == 'paragraph' && cfg.split) color = hot ? cfg.hotColor : count >= cfg.splitCount ? cfg.splitColor : cfg.color
  count = Math.min(count, 999)
  var svg
  if (normalizedKind == 'paragraph') {
    var displayText = String(Math.min(count, 999))
    var custom = cfg.template == '起点' ? '' : qmLoginValue.call(this, cfg.template.replace('样式', '◎ 气泡'), '')
    svg = custom.trim() ? custom.replace(/\$\{qpyscolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{qpwzcolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{font\}/g, 'Arial').replace(/\$\{displayText\}/g, displayText) :
      '<svg viewBox="5 14 45 36" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="180" height="144"><path d="M44 48 Q48 48 48 44 L48 20 Q48 16 44 16 L20 16 Q16 16 16 20 L16 24 S16 28 10 30 Q6 32 10 34 Q16 36 16 38 L16 44 Q16 48 20 48 Z" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="0.7"/><text x="32" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-weight="600" font-size="18" fill="' + color + '" dominant-baseline="middle">' + displayText + '</text></svg>'
  } else if (normalizedKind == 'book' || normalizedKind == 'chapter') {
    svg = '<svg width="1000" height="128" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="6" y="6" width="988" height="116" rx="12" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="3"/><text x="48" y="79" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="38" fill="' + color + '">' + qmEsc(label) + '</text><text x="950" y="79" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial" font-size="34" fill="' + color + '">' + count + ' 条 ›</text></svg>'
  } else {
    svg = '<svg width="1000" height="800" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="150" y="150" width="665" height="525" rx="175" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="18"/><text x="480" y="535" font-family="Arial" text-anchor="middle" font-size="298" fill="' + color + '">' + count + '</text></svg>'
  }
  var encoded = qmBase64Encode(this, svg)
  if (!encoded) return ''
  var call = 'qmOpenComment.call(this,' + [normalizedKind, bid, cid, pid, label || '', checkId || ''].map(function (x) { return JSON.stringify(String(x || '')) }).join(',') + ')'
  var style = normalizedKind == 'paragraph' ? qmCommentConfig.call(this).svgSize : 'FULL'
  return 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + encoded + ',' + JSON.stringify({style:style,type:'qmpl',click:call})
}

function qmBubbleImage(kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot) {
  var data = qmSvg.call(this, kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot)
  return data ? '<img src="' + data + '">' : ''
}

function qmGodImage(bid, cid, pid, gid, text) {
  text = String(text || '').replace(/[\r\n]+/g, ' ').trim()
  if (!gid || !text) return ''
  if (text.length > 18) text = text.slice(0, 18) + '...'
  var svg = '<svg width="1000" height="120" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">' +
    '<rect x="2" y="0" width="996" height="100" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.25)" rx="35" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1"/>' +
    '<rect x="32" y="22" width="140" height="56" rx="20" fill="#FF4444"/>' +
    '<text x="102" y="64" font-size="32" font-family="Segoe UI,Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif" fill="#FFF" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">神评</text>' +
    '<text x="196" y="64" font-size="38" font-family="Segoe UI,Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif" fill="#000" font-weight="bold">' + qmEsc(text) + '</text></svg>'
  var encoded = qmBase64Encode(this, svg)
  if (!encoded) return ''
  var call = 'qmOpenComment.call(this,' + ['paragraph', bid, cid, pid, '七猫神评', gid].map(function (x) { return JSON.stringify(String(x || '')) }).join(',') + ')'
  var data = 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + encoded + ',' + JSON.stringify({style:'FULL',type:'qmpl-god',click:call})
  return '<img src="' + data + '">'
}

function qmChapterReviewCount(bid, cid) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  var key = 'qm-count-chapter-' + bid + '-' + cid
  var saved = runtimeCache && runtimeCache.getFromMemory(key)
  if (saved != null) return Number(saved || 0)
  var data = qmGet.call(this, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/comment/chapter-end-comment', {book_id:bid,chapter_ids:cid}).data || {}
  var comments = data.comments || []
  var count = comments.length ? Number(comments[0].count || 0) : 0
  if (runtimeCache) runtimeCache.putMemory(key, String(count))
  return count
}

function qmBookReviewCount(bid) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  var key = 'qm-count-book-' + bid
  var saved = runtimeCache && runtimeCache.getFromMemory(key)
  if (saved != null) return Number(saved || 0)
  var data = qmGet.call(this, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/community/book-evaluates', {circle_id:bid,need_common:'0',tag_id:'1',book_id:bid,sort:'0'}).data || {}
  var count = Number(data.evaluates_info && data.evaluates_info.eval_comment_count || data.comment_count || 0)
  if (runtimeCache) runtimeCache.putMemory(key, String(count))
  return count
}

function qmNovelContent(text, baseUrl) {
  var ctx = this
  var raw = qmParse(text).data || {}
  var bid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'id')
  var cid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'chapterId')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
  var readerType = qmReaderType(ctx, baseUrl)
  var content = readerType == '3' ? qmEpubRemoteDecrypt.call(ctx, raw.content || '') : qmDecryptChapter(raw.content || '')
  if (!qmCommentsAllowed(ctx, baseUrl)) return content
  var marks = {}
  if (cfg.paragraph || cfg.god) {
    try {
      var bubbleResponse = qmPostForm.call(ctx, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/paragraph/bubbles', {
        book_id:bid,chapters:JSON.stringify([{chapter_id:cid,chapter_md5:String(raw.content_md5 || '')}])
      })
      var chapters = bubbleResponse.data && bubbleResponse.data.chapters || []
      var bubbles = chapters.length ? chapters[0].bubbles || [] : []
      bubbles.forEach(function (item) {
        var count = Number(item.c || 0)
        if (count > 0 || item.gid || item.gtxt) marks[String(item.p)] = {count:count,hot:String(item.hot || '') == '1',gid:String(item.gid || ''),gtxt:String(item.gtxt || '')}
      })
    } catch (bubbleError) {}
  }
  var lines = String(content).split('\n')
  lines.forEach(function (line, index) {
    var pid = qmMd5(line).slice(0, 8)
    var mark = marks[pid]
    if (!mark || !line) return
    var bubble = cfg.paragraph ? qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'paragraph', bid, cid, pid, mark.count, mark.hot ? '热门段评' : '七猫段评', mark.gid, mark.hot) : ''
    if (bubble) lines[index] += bubble
    var god = cfg.god ? qmGodImage.call(ctx, bid, cid, pid, mark.gid, mark.gtxt) : ''
    if (god) lines[index] += '\n' + god
  })
  if (cfg.chapter) try { var chapterBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'chapter', bid, cid, '', qmChapterReviewCount.call(ctx, bid, cid), '本章说'); if (chapterBubble) lines.push(chapterBubble) } catch (chapterError) {}
  if (cfg.book) try { var bookBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'book', bid, '', '', qmBookReviewCount.call(ctx, bid), '本书书评'); if (bookBubble) lines.push(bookBubble) } catch (bookError) {}
  return lines.join('\n')
}

function qmContentTitle(value, baseUrl) {
  var text = String(value || '')
  var runtimeChapter = qmChapterOf(this)
  try { if (runtimeChapter) runtimeChapter.putImgUrl(null) } catch (e) {}
  return text
}

function qmReadContent(text, baseUrl) {
  if (/^data:;base64,/.test(String(baseUrl)) && /["']type["']\s*:\s*["']video["']/.test(String(baseUrl))) {
    return qmHexDecodeAscii(text)
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/playlet/api/info') >= 0) {
    var video = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var playList = video.play_list || []
    var sort = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'qm_sort')
    var runtimeChapter = qmChapterOf(this)
    if (!sort) {
      try {
        var titleMatch = String(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.title || '').match(/第\s*(\d+)\s*集/)
        if (titleMatch) sort = titleMatch[1]
      } catch (titleError) {}
    }
    var item = playList.filter(function (x) { return sort && String(x.sort) == String(sort) })[0]
    if (!item) {
      var chapterIndex = -1
      try { chapterIndex = Number(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.index) } catch (indexError) {}
      if (chapterIndex >= 0) item = playList[chapterIndex]
    }
    if (!item) item = playList.filter(function (x) { return !!(x.video_url || x.video_url_h265) })[0] || {}
    return String(item.video_url || item.video_url_h265 || '')
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/album/info') >= 0) {
    var audio = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var voices = audio.voice_list || []
    return voices.length ? String(voices[0].voice_url) : '本集暂无可播放音频'
  }
  return qmNovelContent.call(this, text, baseUrl)
}

var JsDom = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup;

// 获取包含<li>元素的<div>元素
var divs = document.select('ul.list > div');

// 将divs转换为数组以便排序
var divArray = [];
for (var i = 0; i < divs.size(); i++) {
    divArray.push(divs.get(i));
}

// 按照data-id属性对divArray进行排序
divArray.sort(function(a, b) {
    var pageA = parseInt(a.attr('data-id'), 10);
    var pageB = parseInt(b.attr('data-id'), 10);
    return pageA - pageB;
});

var list = [];
// 遍历排序后的divArray
for (var i = 0; i < divArray.length; i++) {
    var div = divArray[i];
    var dataId = div.attr('data-id');
    // 获取当前div下的所有<li>元素
    var lis = div.select('li');
    for (var j = 0; j < lis.size(); j++) {
        var li = lis.get(j);
        var a = li.select('a').first();
        if (a != null) {
            list.push({
                text: a.text(),
                id: dataId, // 使用data-id属性
                url: a.attr('href')
            });
        }
    }
}

source.exploreUrl:
<js>
eval(String(source.loginUrl));
function explore(title, url, num, num_1, bool) {
    style = '{\n    title: "' + title + '",\n    url: "' + url + '",\n    style: {\n      layout_flexGrow: ' + num + ',\n      layout_flexBasisPercent: ' + num_1 + ',\n      layout_wrapBefore: ' + bool + '\n    }\n  }';
    return style;
}
var exploreUrl = [];
title = '✣　　　　　  ✣  分　　类  ✣  　　　　　✣';
exploreUrl.push(explore(title, '', 1, 1, false));
rank = [
    '全部漫画',
    '最新上架'
];
orderby = [
    '/classify',
    '/list/new'
];
for (i in rank) {
    url = `{{Get('url')}}${orderby[i]}?page={{page}}`;
    exploreUrl.push(explore(rank[i], url, 1, 0.45, false));
}
title = '✣　　　　　  ✣  标　　签  ✣  　　　　　✣';
exploreUrl.push(explore(title, '', 1, 1, false));
kind = [
    '全部','恋爱','纯爱','古风','异能','悬疑','剧情','科幻',
    '奇幻','玄幻','穿越','冒险','推理','武侠','格斗','战争',
    '热血','搞笑','大女主','都市','总裁','后宫','日常','韩漫',
    '少年','其他'
];
type = [
    'type=all','type=lianai','type=chunai','type=gufeng','type=yineng','type=xuanyi','type=juqing','type=kehuan',
    'type=qihuan','type=xuanhuan','type=chuanyue','type=mouxian','type=tuili','type=wuxia','type=gedou','type=zhanzheng',
    'type=rexie','type=gaoxiao','type=danuzhu','type=dushi','type=zongcai','type=hougong','type=richang','type=hanman',
    'type=shaonian','type=qita'
];
Region = `{{get('region',Get('o'))}}`;
State = `{{get('state',Get('q'))}}`;
Filter = `{{get('filter',Get('p'))}}`;
for (j in kind) {
    url = `{{Get('url')}}/classify?${type[j]}${Region}${State}${Filter}&page={{page}}`;
    exploreUrl.push(explore(kind[j], url, 1, 0.2, false));
}
BID = (kind.length % 4) < 1 ? 0 : (4 - (kind.length % 4));
for (i = 0; i < BID; i++) {
   exploreUrl.push(explore('', '', 1, 0.2, false)); 
}
//exploreUrl.splice(30, 0, explore('', '', 1, 0.2, false));
var exploreUrlStr = '[' + exploreUrl.join(",") + ']';
exploreUrlStr;
</js>

function explore(title, url, num, num_1, bool) {
    style = '{\n    title: "' + title + '",\n    url: "' + url + '",\n    style: {\n      layout_flexGrow: ' + num + ',\n      layout_flexBasisPercent: ' + num_1 + ',\n      layout_wrapBefore: ' + bool + '\n    }\n  }';
    return style;
}
var exploreUrl = [];
title = '✣　　　　　  ✣  分　　类  ✣  　　　　　✣';
exploreUrl.push(explore(title, '', 1, 1, false));
rank = [
    '全部漫画',
    '最新上架'
];
orderby = [
    '/classify',
    '/list/new'
];
for (i in rank) {
    url = `{{Get('url')}}${orderby[i]}?page={{page}}`;
    exploreUrl.push(explore(rank[i], url, 1, 0.45, false));
}
title = '✣　　　　　  ✣  标　　签  ✣  　　　　　✣';
exploreUrl.push(explore(title, '', 1, 1, false));
kind = [
    '全部','恋爱','纯爱','古风','异能','悬疑','剧情','科幻',
    '奇幻','玄幻','穿越','冒险','推理','武侠','格斗','战争',

];

    'type=qihuan','type=xuanhuan','type=chuanyue','type=mouxian','type=tuili','type=wuxia','type=gedou','type=zhanzheng',

    'type=shaonian','type=qita'
];
Region = `{{get('region',Get('o'))}}`;
State = `{{get('state',Get('q'))}}`;
Filter = `{{get('filter',Get('p'))}}`;
for (j in kind) {
    url = `{{Get('url')}}/classify?${type[j]}${Region}${State}${Filter}&page={{page}}`;
    exploreUrl.push(explore(kind[j], url, 1, 0.2, false));
}
BID = (kind.length % 4) < 1 ? 0 : (4 - (kind.length % 4));
for (i = 0; i < BID; i++) {
   exploreUrl.push(explore('', '', 1, 0.2, false)); 
}
//exploreUrl.splice(30, 0, explore('', '', 1, 0.2, false));
var exploreUrlStr = '[' + exploreUrl.join(",") + ']';
exploreUrlStr;

source.bookSourceComment:
2026.11.04 基于 https://github.com/ch6vip/fqapp 书旗(shuqi)上游协议制作的 Legado 纯 APP 接口书源。

【协议】纯JS复现官方 App 加密口：2048字节 keystream 二进制 XOR + base64（data 与 x-sq-public 各自从 keystream[0] 起算）+ MD5 签名（按键名升序拼 k=v& + skey 盐）+ enc18 派生 + 36键 x-sq-public（体内 platform=an / 头内 platform=2）。黄金向量与 Rust 单测逐一比对通过。

【链路】搜索=render/search/native_v3；详情=reader/titlepage；目录=H5 /chapter?bid= 全量真章名，H5缺失(部分新书返回55字节location.replace)时降级 content.shuqireader.com/openapi/book/chapterlist（bscpubKey+MD5签名，卷数组→真章名+chapterId）；正文=免签 CDN JSONP 明文（2host×2flag×2scheme，VIP章亦可），失败降级 chapterinfo ROT13+base64；发现=H5 19个榜单 + 书库分类（服务端渲染，支持分页）。
【卷名】仅当站点本身分卷(≥2卷且有卷名)时，在每卷第一章名前标注一次【卷名】；单卷/无卷名不加，章名保持原样。

【UA】必须 okhttp/3.12.13：实测 www.shuqi.com 对浏览器 UA 一律返回 1120 字节 403 拦截页（伪装成正常 HTML），headers 键名必须大写 'User-Agent'。

【登录】游客态完全可用，无需登录；登录界面仅提供状态检查/线路测速/切换/重置设备身份。
【限频】concurrentRate=1/3000 且搜索规则内置 3 秒最小间隔，避免触发风控。
【兼容】LegadoTeam 官方版 + legado-E（全纯JS，不依赖 BouncyCastle/android.util.Base64）。
【注意】目录 H5 页约 1.2MB/本；搜索接口不支持分页（page 参数是模块名常量）。

source.bookSourceComment:
2026.11.04 基于 https://github.com/ch6vip/fqapp 书旗(shuqi)上游协议制作的 Legado 纯 APP 接口书源。

【协议】纯JS复现官方 App 加密口：2048字节 keystream 二进制 XOR + base64（data 与 x-sq-public 各自从 keystream[0] 起算）+ MD5 签名（按键名升序拼 k=v& + skey 盐）+ enc18 派生 + 36键 x-sq-public（体内 platform=an / 头内 platform=2）。黄金向量与 Rust 单测逐一比对通过。

【链路】搜索=render/search/native_v3；详情=reader/titlepage；目录=H5 /chapter?bid= 全量真章名，H5缺失(部分新书返回55字节location.replace)时降级 content.shuqireader.com/openapi/book/chapterlist（bscpubKey+MD5签名，卷数组→真章名+chapterId）；正文=免签 CDN JSONP 明文（2host×2flag×2scheme，VIP章亦可），失败降级 chapterinfo ROT13+base64；发现=H5 19个榜单 + 书库分类（服务端渲染，支持分页）。
【卷名】仅当站点本身分卷(≥2卷且有卷名)时，在每卷第一章名前标注一次【卷名】；单卷/无卷名不加，章名保持原样。

【UA】必须 okhttp/3.12.13：实测 www.shuqi.com 对浏览器 UA 一律返回 1120 字节 403 拦截页（伪装成正常 HTML），headers 键名必须大写 'User-Agent'。

【登录】游客态完全可用，无需登录；登录界面仅提供状态检查/线路测速/切换/重置设备身份。
【限频】concurrentRate=1/3000 且搜索规则内置 3 秒最小间隔，避免触发风控。
【兼容】LegadoTeam 官方版 + legado-E（全纯JS，不依赖 BouncyCastle/android.util.Base64）。
【注意】目录 H5 页约 1.2MB/本；搜索接口不支持分页（page 参数是模块名常量）。
